result.intro: your people in san antonio are basically gabe + lena being like don't overthink it. pearl at night, missions in the day, river walk for 20 mins max.

items.title: pearl at dusk
items.what: gabe's saturday ritual. ground fountains lit pink + blue, kid and dog losing it in the spray, string-light trees, old brewery chimney behind. just walk, only spend if you want tacos.
items.whyYou: you're night owls + foodies so this is your lane — pretty lights to linger, optional $12 taco cave.
items.priceHint: free to walk, $12 tacos if you cave

evidence.caption: pearl at dusk. the ground fountains lit up, trees wrapped in string lights, a kid and a dog losing their minds in the spray, the old brewery chimney behind it all. saturday ritual. free to walk, $12 tacos if you cave #sanantonio #thepearl
evidence.sawLive: at dusk the lit ground fountains are spraying pink and blue while a kid and a dog play in them, with string-light trees and the pearl chimney behind. the caption says it's free to walk/hang, but $12 tacos if you cave.

items.title: mission san josé with abuela energy
items.what: long wall of weathered stone arches, two rows, green bushes in front. quiet, 300 years old, national park. light a candle, wander slow.
items.whyYou: art people thing — textures, arches, cloudy-day photos. and it's free so your $120 stays intact.

evidence.caption: mission san josé with abuela on a cloudy sunday. the long wall of stone arches, two rows, green bushes in front, weathered like it's been there 300 years because it has. free. national park. she lit a candle and then made me drive her to h-e-b. spare room in southtown is open, she WILL cook for you
evidence.sawLive: up close it's a weathered stone wall with two rows of arches and green bushes in front under a cloudy sky. feels quiet and old, and it's free so yeah good for a low-cost visit.

items.title: river walk dusk cameo
items.what: stone bridge, trees lit purple + green, boat with red lights way down the water. lena says 20 mins max, then go eat at the pearl after, don't eat down here.
items.whyYou: night owls quick hit — you get the lit-up water pics without wasting a whole night, and gabe backs the no-food-down-here rule.

evidence.caption: took my out of town cousin to the river walk against my will. dusk is the only acceptable time: stone bridge, trees lit purple and green, a boat with red lights way down the water. still not a fan but I get it for 20 minutes. go eat at the pearl after, don't eat down here
